title: agriphyllum fruticosum
intro: Agriphyllum fruticosum, commonly known as Fructus Agriphylli, is a type of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Agriphyllum fruticosum include its ability to inhibit platelet aggregation, lower blood pressure, and reduce oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenoids and flavonoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
